in_marathi.name: Ivanshi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ivanshi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ivanshi is a Sanskrit name derived from the goddess of prosperity and abundance, Shri. It symbolizes wealth, happiness, and success in all aspects of life. This name was given to girls born under the belief that they would bring prosperity to their families.
